healthy.name: Balanced potato NPK fertilizer
healthy.guidance: Use only when a soil test or the normal crop schedule shows a need. If required, side-dress beside the row during hilling and follow the product label.
healthy.caution: The plant appears healthy. Extra fertilizer is not a treatment and over-application can burn roots or create weak, disease-prone growth.

early_blight.name: Balanced potato fertilizer with potassium
early_blight.guidance: Early blight is not a nutrient deficiency. Continue the normal potato feeding programme only if a soil test shows a need, using a balanced potato blend rather than extra nitrogen.
early_blight.caution: Fertilizer will not cure early blight. Remove infected leaves and control the fungal disease first; avoid heavy nitrogen applications.

late_blight.name: Balanced potato fertilizer with potassium
late_blight.guidance: Late blight is not a nutrient deficiency. Continue the normal potato feeding programme only if a soil test shows a need, using a balanced potato blend rather than extra nitrogen.
late_blight.caution: Fertilizer will not stop late blight. Treat the infection urgently and avoid adding heavy nitrogen to badly infected plants.

healthy.name: Low-nitrogen tomato fertilizer
healthy.guidance: Apply phosphorus and potassium only where a soil test recommends them. Use a low-nitrogen tomato fertilizer as part of the normal feeding schedule once fruit begins to develop.
healthy.caution: Too much nitrogen produces leafy growth and can delay fruiting. Do not add fertilizer simply because a diagnosis was performed.

early_blight.name: Low-nitrogen tomato fertilizer with potassium
early_blight.guidance: Early blight is fungal, not a nutrient deficiency. Maintain normal nutrition only if soil testing shows a need; choose a low-nitrogen tomato fertilizer rather than pushing leafy growth.
early_blight.caution: Fertilizer does not cure early blight. Prune infected leaves and use the recommended disease treatment first.

late_blight.name: Low-nitrogen tomato fertilizer with potassium
late_blight.guidance: Late blight is a water-mould disease, not a nutrient deficiency. Maintain normal nutrition only if soil testing shows a need.
late_blight.caution: Fertilizer will not stop late blight. Control the infection immediately and avoid fertilizing severely damaged plants.

leaf_mold.name: Low-nitrogen tomato fertilizer with potassium
leaf_mold.guidance: Leaf mold is fungal. Use fertilizer only to maintain the normal crop programme when a soil test indicates a need, and prioritize ventilation and disease control.
leaf_mold.caution: Do not use fertilizer as a leaf-mold treatment. Excess nitrogen can create dense foliage that holds humidity.

septoria_leaf_spot.name: Low-nitrogen tomato fertilizer with potassium
septoria_leaf_spot.guidance: Septoria leaf spot is fungal. Continue normal feeding only where soil testing indicates a nutrient need.
septoria_leaf_spot.caution: Fertilizer does not cure Septoria. Remove infected foliage and follow the recommended disease-control steps.

bacterial_spot.name: Low-nitrogen tomato fertilizer with potassium
bacterial_spot.guidance: Bacterial spot is an infection, not a nutrient deficiency. Keep unaffected plants on their normal soil-test-based feeding programme.
bacterial_spot.caution: Fertilizer cannot kill the bacteria. Avoid heavy nitrogen and focus on sanitation and the recommended bactericide.

spider_mites.name: Balanced low-nitrogen tomato fertilizer
spider_mites.guidance: Spider mites are pests, not a nutrient deficiency. Maintain normal feeding only if the crop needs it and keep plants evenly watered.
spider_mites.caution: Fertilizer will not control mites. Avoid excess nitrogen, which can encourage soft new growth.

target_spot.name: Low-nitrogen tomato fertilizer with potassium
target_spot.guidance: Target spot is fungal. Maintain normal soil-test-based nutrition while treating the disease, without adding extra nitrogen.
target_spot.caution: Fertilizer is supportive only and will not cure target spot.

yellow_leaf_curl_virus.guidance: No corrective fertilizer is recommended for an infected plant. Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus has no fertilizer cure; maintain normal nutrition only for unaffected plants.
yellow_leaf_curl_virus.caution: Do not spend extra fertilizer trying to recover a severely infected plant. Remove infected plants and control whiteflies.

mosaic_virus.guidance: No corrective fertilizer is recommended for an infected plant. Mosaic virus has no fertilizer cure; maintain normal nutrition only for unaffected plants.
mosaic_virus.caution: Remove infected plants and disinfect tools. Extra fertilizer will not remove the virus.

healthy.name: Compound D or balanced NPK basal fertilizer, followed by AN or urea if needed
healthy.guidance: Choose the basal and top-dressing programme from a soil test, expected yield, crop stage, and local agronomist guidance.
healthy.caution: Do not guess the nitrogen rate. Too much or poorly timed nitrogen wastes money and can damage the crop or environment.

common_rust.name: Soil-test-based maize NPK with correctly timed nitrogen top-dressing
common_rust.guidance: Common rust is fungal, not a nutrient deficiency. Keep the crop on its normal basal and top-dressing programme only where soil and crop stage support it.
common_rust.caution: Fertilizer will not cure rust. Avoid adding extra nitrogen as a response to leaf symptoms.

northern_leaf_blight.name: Soil-test-based maize NPK with correctly timed nitrogen top-dressing
northern_leaf_blight.guidance: Northern leaf blight is fungal. Continue the planned maize fertilizer programme only if soil testing and crop stage show that nutrients are due.
northern_leaf_blight.caution: Fertilizer is not a blight treatment. Use disease control and residue management, and do not apply extra nitrogen to compensate for damaged leaves.

gray_leaf_spot.name: Soil-test-based maize NPK with correctly timed nitrogen top-dressing
gray_leaf_spot.guidance: Gray leaf spot is fungal. Maintain the planned soil-test-based fertilizer schedule while controlling the disease and managing crop residue.
gray_leaf_spot.caution: Extra fertilizer will not cure gray leaf spot. Avoid unnecessary nitrogen applications.
